contract.root: Caller-authorized canonical .ai-novel storage directory; not project root
contract.verify: verifyGenerationKnowledge({projectStorageRoot,snapshot}) -> Promise<void>; exact original IDs, no new search or embedding

proof: Canonical chunk IDs and document IDs retained even when fileName and text are equal.
Original chunk UTF-8 hash, exact ordered document chunk-set hash and document completeness checked.
Vector hits must exactly match canonical identity, text and corpus metadata.
Snapshot uses actual canonical/documents table versions; same-name replacement and version change reject.
Read pins table snapshots and checks latest versions and registry bytes before returning; actual concurrent mutation counterexample covered.
Capture/verify do not migrate, create missing stores, register embedding spaces or call a provider; successful capture+verify physical source hash unchanged.
14 vector-store public entries including legacy lazy-write reads are serialized under the main-owned reentrant gate; 7 explicit mutators included.
Synchronous close and migration fence acquisition reject while a foreign gate scope is busy. Original migration FENCED refusal precedence preserved.
boundaries: Main must retain/bind prepared snapshots; these functions do not authenticate a renderer-created snapshot.
Main controller must hold the shared gate across verification and its SQLite effect; this foundation alone is not cross-database atomicity.
External processes and arbitrary filesystem replacement are not excluded by an in-process mutex.
Unknown corpus remains unknown, not finalized author authority. Reference corpus is excluded to match existing writing-context retrieval.
Table-level revision comparison is intentionally conservative; unrelated canonical mutations can stale a prepared context.
Embedding query vectors may be supplied by trusted main preparation; re-verification never uses them.
No real model, production author data or ABI switch used.
initialSnapshot: The tests, files and gateDependency above describe the original producer snapshot. Subsequent integration repairs are covered by independentReview below; earlier hashes are retained as historical evidence.
